note: Current default plans, exported without the car. Each image is a material-and-lighting pass on its own exact 3D view. Original photographs and populated drafts were used during exploration; final geometry-preserving outputs use the current 3D reference only. Generated details are illustrative; the source model is the dimension authority.

plans.label: A · 40 cm · open floor
plans.prompt: Edit this exact CGI image into a realistic architectural photograph. CRITICAL: treat the input as a locked geometric photograph. Keep the image composition, camera position, perspective, every object's silhouette, every shelf edge and every basket wire basket location EXACTLY where they are. Do NOT redesign, add, remove or reposition ANY shelving, beams, storage furniture or baskets. Even unusually large empty shelf openings are intentional and must stay exactly as drawn. All the many white wire baskets on the LEFT wall, both high and low, must remain. Do not join separate baskets. Do not fill empty gaps. Change ONLY the visual rendering: replace flat-looking timber with realistic knotty pine grain, improve realistic diffuse light and contact shadows, show physical matte painted steel, believable concrete and fabric textures. The existing simple bag shapes can gain seams and cloth folds at the same scale, but don't add new objects. The white ladder can look like aluminium and the black snow sled can gain realistic surface texture while keeping their exact positions. Room must look clean and organized. Maintain the solid loft and every beam. No car, no people, no text, no new furniture, no added shelves, no added boxes. A surface/material realism pass, with the geometry locked to the input.
plans.review: Compared with this plan’s fresh source: left-wall upper and lower basket rows, charger gap, rear shelving system and shelf openings, one sled, ladder, right-wall gear, loft and projected rack front edge. Populated variants that invented shelf levels were rejected.
